author: codex-maclaptop
why: The Brain's open list carried four audits as 'outside the sweep, unclassified and unblocking'. Unclassified is worse than red: nobody knows whether to act. Each was run and is now either green or has a named, non-game reason for being red.

detail.reason: Seventeen initial shots, dry fire, pickups, bike/foot reload conservation, possession, interrupted reload and reserve cap pass
Saved frame, island and persistent swimmer/bank separation checked

results.classification: green - the wipeout is the swimmer fixture doing its job, not a failure

not a game defect: with the sweep's own -nosound the audio component never reports Playing, so the audit failed on the flag. It is now a sweep entry carrying a WithAudio token that drops -nosound for that audit only - the same trap as NoSkipTutorial, one flag over. Verified through the sweep script: BATTLE_SWEEP_ONLY=BattleMusicAudit -> pass.

results.verdict: pass on its review map, not applicable to the main world

detail.reason: Both opposing road lanes traversed with wheel support and endpoint stops

results.classification: The audit collects actors tagged TenthCarLaneReview (or MonroeCarLaneReview with -BattleMonroeLanes). Those live in Content/PiedmontRide/Maps/PiedmontCarLaneReview, which is deliberately not cooked into the share, so: against PiedmontWorld it always says 'Expected opposing lane candidates' (0 cars, no lane-review actors exist there) and from a packaged build it cannot load the map at all. It passes in the editor against the review map. Scripts/run_road_lane_audit.sh now runs it the correct way and is documented with both traps.

sweep_after: The sweep is 30 entries with the music audit added; the other three were already green or are runner-script audits rather than sweep entries.
